title: Concealed twin under-deck TMD retrofit for 40 m footbridge
problem_restatement: 40 m footbridge with lively 1.9 Hz first vertical bending mode needs concealed under-deck retrofit with zero deck sightline change to add damping and reduce crowd acceleration.
mechanism_sentence: Twin 250-kg masses on coil springs with viscous dampers hung at the midspan antinode resonate at 1.81 Hz to absorb the 1.9 Hz bending-mode energy, raising effective damping to 9.44% and cutting crowd acceleration to 0.74 m/s2.
decisive_choices: Place twin 250kg units for 5% mass ratio at midspan antinode tuned to 1.81 Hz with 13.36% damper damping per Den Hartog optimum
Hang units below soffit on transverse SHS clamp beams U-bolted to existing cross-girders with zero hardware above deck
Accept CL2 0.74 m/s2 with 9.44% effective damping and 20.0 mm travel as retrofit comfort outcome
open_question: What is the capacity of the existing host cross-girders for 2x250kg static plus dynamic TMD force, since only new clamp beams were checked?
transfer_line: Load: Crowd walking force -> Midspan deck antinode -> Twin TMD masses with springs/dampers on clamp beams | Measured: Midspan accelerometer -> Setra comfort assessment

assumed_constraints.constraint: First vertical bending half-sine mode at 1.9 Hz with 0.4-0.5% inherent damping and ~10000 kg modal mass with antinode at midspan
Comfort target CL1 vertical <0.5 m/s2 per Setra/Hivoss, retrofit accepted as CL2 <1.0 m/s2 at 0.74 m/s2

functional_decomposition: Confirm first vertical bending mode and damping baseline
Add under-deck damping without changing deck sightlines
Conceal all retrofit hardware below soffit or inside parapet voids with zero change to deck sightlines, with maintainable connections and finishes

concept.working_principle: Under-deck tuned mass damper at midspan antinode tuned to 1.81 Hz with 5% mass ratio and 13.36% damper damping absorbs first 1.9 Hz bending-mode energy, raising effective damping from 0.4% to 9.44% while hidden below girders with zero deck change.

parts.name: TMD mass block 250kg
parts.function: provide 250kg tuned mass at midspan antinode

parts.name: coil spring
parts.function: provide TMD stiffness tuned to 1.81 Hz

parts.name: transverse clamp beam SHS 100x6mm
parts.function: support twin TMD units below soffit

parts.name: soffit access hatch and parapet-void cover

loads.label: crowd resonant force 1400 N at 1.9 Hz

measurement_chain.name: frequency-sweep analyzer for 1.81 Hz tuning and damper check

fabrication_steps.description: Pre-assemble paired 250kg TMD units on coil springs with viscous dampers
Night-time lane-by-lane install of transverse SHS clamp beams U-bolted to existing cross-girders from mobile scaffold with no deck closure
Hang TMD units below soffit with 150mm clearance envelope, deck-matching soffit paint and soffit hatches plus removable parapet-void covers
Commission by frequency-sweep tuning to 1.81 Hz and damper check, then 6-monthly visual inspection and annual re-tuning from soffit hatches per Setra/Hivoss verification

risks.risk: Host cross-girder capacity for 2x250kg plus dynamic TMD force not checked; only new clamp beam checked
risks.mitigation: Compute existing cross-girder bending and shear including dynamic TMD force per Eurocode

risks.risk: U-bolt preload/slip margin not fully linked
risks.mitigation: Link 30 kN preload per U-bolt with serrated plates to 36 kN friction vs 2452.5 N weight for 14.68 slip margin

risks.risk: Comfort target drift from CL1 <0.5 m/s2 to CL2 0.74 m/s2
risks.mitigation: Explicitly accept CL2 <1.0 m/s2 at 0.74 m/s2 as comfortable retrofit outcome per Setra/Hivoss

novelty_claim: Concealed twin 250-kg under-deck TMD on U-bolted clamp beams with zero hardware above deck and soffit-hatch maintenance

figure_spec.system_view: Under-deck twin TMD units at midspan, masses on coil springs with viscous dampers hung below girders, deck clear

open_questions: What is the capacity of the existing host cross-girders for 2x250kg static plus dynamic TMD force, since only new clamp beams were checked?
Is U-bolt preload/slip margin with 14.68 factor fully linked to preload calculation to close slip objection?
